Query.Resource: ("OPERATOR INFORMATION")
"Report Generated: " & now as string
("Report Version: 1.0")
"Number of Console Operators: " & number of bes users as string
"Number of Master Operators: " & number of bes users whose (master flag of it = true) as string
"Number of Non-Master Operators: " & number of bes users whose (master flag of it = false) as string

"Average Number of Computers Managed by Non-Master Operators: " & ((if (exists bes users whose (not master flag of it) ) then ( mean of (if (exists administered computers of it) then (number of administered computers of it) else 0) of bes users whose (not master flag of it) as integer) else 0) as string)

Result.Answer: Average Number of Computers Managed by Non-Master Operators: 2477

Query.Resource: "Minimum Number of Computers Managed: " & minimum of (number of administered computers of it) of bes users as string
"Maximum Number of Computers Managed: " & maximum of (number of administered computers of it) of bes users as string
"Number of Custom Content Authors: " & number of bes users whose (custom content flag of it = true) as string
"Average Days Last Logged In: " & mean of ((now - last login time of it) /day) of bes users whose (exists last login time of it) as integer as string
"Number of Operators Never Logged In: " & number of bes users whose (not exists last login time of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of Operators Never Logged In: 1

Query.Resource: "Number of Operators Not Logged for Three Months: " & number of bes users whose (exists last login time of it AND (now - last login time of it > 13 * week)) as string

Result.Answer: Number of Operators Not Logged for Three Months: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of Operators Not Logged for One Month: " & number of bes users whose (exists last login time of it AND (now - last login time of it < 4 * week)) as string

Result.Answer: Number of Operators Not Logged for One Month: 2

Query.Resource: "Number of operators created within the last 24 hours: " & number of bes users whose (( exist creation time of it) and ( creation time of it >= (now - 24*hour) )) as string

Result.Answer: Number of operators created within the last 24 hours: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of operators logged in within the last 24 hours: " & number of bes users whose (( exist last login time of it) and ( last login time of it >= (now - 24 * hour) )) as string

Result.Answer: Number of operators logged in within the last 24 hours: 2

Query.Resource: "Number of operators that have not logged in for over 90 days: " & number of bes users whose ( (exist last login time of it and last login time of it <= (now - 90*day)) and exist last login time of it ) as string

Result.Answer: Number of operators that have not logged in for over 90 days: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of operators that have not logged in for over 60 days: " & number of bes users whose ( (exist last login time of it and last login time of it <= (now - 60*day)) and exist last login time of it ) as string

Result.Answer: Number of operators that have not logged in for over 60 days: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of operators that have not logged in for over 30 days: " & number of bes users whose ( (exist last login time of it and last login time of it <= (now - 30*day)) and exist last login time of it ) as string

Result.Answer: Number of operators that have not logged in for over 30 days: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of operators that have never logged in: " & number of bes users whose ( not (exist last login time of it )) as string

Result.Answer: Number of operators that have never logged in: 1

Query.Resource: "Number of Bes Roles: " & (number of bes roles as string)
